admission.justification: One bounded locator is produced by the locator module, settled by the report-path owner, published by the hand-over publication and named by the artifact reference; no single place can keep the path depth-independent without the others.

applicability: Every role launch that publishes a hand-over artifact, on every start route and at any report-folder depth.
conditions: The locator is a directory alias named by the launch's durable request id under the product's own durable root, and the artifact keeps its own basename, canonical bytes, mode 0444 and write-once behavior beside the report.
The locator's length is the root, one request id and the artifact's basename; the report folder's path is not part of it.
Directory links of the report folder are resolved, and a link at the artifact's own name is never followed.
exclusions: The recovery note's own 600-character bound and the first message's content, which the other clauses of this requirement carry.
A launch recorded by an older build that named the artifact beside the report without a locator.
statement: Each launch request names its immutable report-adjacent handover through one durable directory locator whose path does not depend on report-folder depth.
